name: Treadmill Incline Walk
steps: Step onto the stopped treadmill and start at a comfortable walking pace before gradually raising the incline.
Lean very slightly forward from your ankles to match the incline while keeping your spine long and core lightly braced.
Take steady, deliberate alternating strides, driving smoothly through your heels, glutes, and calves on each step.
Continue walking smoothly for the target duration or distance before lowering the incline and speed gradually to cool down.
tips: Avoid gripping the front console or side rails, which drastically reduces the workload of the incline.
Use a moderate speed you can maintain with natural arm swing and tall posture.
